blocks.title: What Keap is NOT intended for

items.title: Limit 1
items.body: Base plans start at list price annually for two users; additional users are list price each.

items.title: Limit 2
items.body: Contact capacity and voice/SMS allotments scale by Max tier; overages apply for texts/voice minutes.

items.title: Limit 3
items.body: Annual contracts may include a documented early-termination fee (list price) if cancelled before term end.

items.title: Limit 4
items.body: Not positioned as a lightweight pipeline-only CRM; buyers seeking Gmail-native or free forever CRM should compare Streak/Capsule.

items.title: Limit 5
items.body: High entry price versus simple CRM alternatives

items.title: Limit 6
items.body: Additional users add list price each on top of base plans
